Interface ModelInterface

All Known Implementing Classes:
GameManager
public interface ModelInterface
Contract exposed by the model to the network layer (Socket / RMI handlers).

ModelInterface is the single boundary through which the server drives the game logic: it groups the lobby operations (joining a game), the in-game player actions (placing a totem, taking a card) and the queries needed to keep clients informed (snapshots, game state, disconnection handling). The reference implementation is GameManager, which coordinates all concurrent game sessions.

  • Method Details

    • joinGame

      JoinResult joinGame(int numPlayers, String nickname)
      Handles a player's request to join (or reconnect to) a game of the given size.
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - the desired game size (typically between 2 and 5 inclusive)
      nickname - the player's chosen display name
      Returns:
      a JoinResult carrying the current game snapshot and whether the game has started

    • placeTotem

      List<GameDelta> placeTotem(String nickname, char position)
      Processes a totem-placement move for the given player.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player placing the totem
      position - the offer-track slot on which the totem is placed
      Returns:
      the list of GameDelta objects produced by the move, to be forwarded to clients

    • takeCard

      List<GameDelta> takeCard(String name, String cardId)
      Processes a card-take move for the given player.
      Parameters:
      name - the nickname of the player taking the card
      cardId - the identifier of the card to take
      Returns:
      the list of GameDelta objects produced by the move; when the move ends the game, the list may also include the final leaderboard update

    • getSnapshotForNickname

      GameSnapshot getSnapshotForNickname(String nickname)
      Returns a fresh snapshot of the game the given player is currently in.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player's nickname
      Returns:
      the current GameSnapshot

    • isGameFull

      boolean isGameFull(String nickname)
      Returns whether the game the given player belongs to has reached its maximum size.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player's nickname
      Returns:
      true if the game is full, false otherwise

    • getPlayersInGame

      List<String> getPlayersInGame(String nickname)
      Returns the nicknames of all players in the same game as the given player.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of any player in the target game
      Returns:
      the list of nicknames in that game

    • handleClientDisconnect

      List<String> handleClientDisconnect(String nickname)
      Cleans up the server-side state of a disconnecting client's game.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the disconnecting player
      Returns:
      the nicknames of the other players in the same game, so they can be notified; empty if the player had not joined any game
